note: Magitek Wars generation list for the local Audio Studio on EVILAEGIS (port 7890), run by tools/audio/gen.mjs. ids are the delivery file names under public/audio/. sfx ids match LogEntry.k so src/audio/audio.ts plays them by name; a kind without a sample plays its synthesized voice. Steam, brass, iron and gloam: no crystal, no published game's sounds. Loops are made seamless by level.mjs.
